name: HefestoAI
description: Release truth engine for AI-generated code. Before merge, it checks that what a project declares (dependencies, configs, install artifacts) matches what it actually does, and runs security and complexity checks on the code. Analyzers for 22 formats (7 code languages + 15 DevOps/IaC); hefesto analyze runs 13 of them today.

skills.name: Code Analysis
skills.description: Analyze code files or directories with the local hefesto CLI (hefesto analyze) for security vulnerabilities, complexity issues, semantic drift, and code smells. The package ships analyzers for 22 formats (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C#, plus 15 DevOps and Cloud IaC formats including COBOL); hefesto analyze runs 13 of them today.

skills.name: Security Scanning
skills.description: Detect HARDCODED_SECRET, SQL_INJECTION, COMMAND_INJECTION, PATH_TRAVERSAL, UNSAFE_DESERIALIZATION and other security vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Semantic Drift Detection
skills.description: Detect when AI-generated code deviates from intended behavior. Validates that code does what the prompt asked for.

authentication.credentials: Set HEFESTO_API_KEY environment variable or X-API-Key header
